I’ve noticed they’ve been more distant, and honestly, I’m not entirely sure why the tension has stayed this high for this long. It feels like we are just seeing things differently now. How would you read a situation like this?. I tried to be honest about how I handle things, but they just keep calling me heartless and saying I abandoned them during the hardest time.Actually, I just texted saying 'arrangements are your thing' since I'm not good with grief. I didn't call or come home; I just hiked for myself.So then, they explode because I stood back with arms crossed, calling my silence a 'wall' and saying my Instagram hike rejected our shared history.Honestly, I'm just principled—isn't it better than faking? I left early for their process while they sorted things; why is my stoicism a crime?I just feel so wronged because I was honestly just trying to be true to myself during a tragedy. Tell me honestly, did I do something wrong?
